description: This Java source file defines a mock actor class `MockProxyActor` used in testing message forwarding within an Akka actor system. It includes static methods for creating the actor and an inner class `MockInnerActor` that handles message forwarding logic.

classes.name: MockProxyActor
classes.description: A mock actor that forwards all messages to a stored ActorRef, used for testing message forwarding.

classes.name: MockInnerActor
classes.description: A private static inner class of MockProxyActor that receives messages, stores the ActorRef to forward to, and performs message forwarding.

methods.name: create
methods.description: A static method to instantiate the MockProxyActor within the provided ActorSystem, assigning it the name 'connectivityRoot'.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Overrides the AbstractActor's preStart method to create the inner proxy actor named 'connectivityProxyActor'.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the receive behavior for MockProxyActor, which in this case does nothing.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the receive behavior for MockInnerActor, handling messages of type ActorRef and forwarding any other message.
